d: Long honey-blonde hair flows down to the waist with straight texture and blunt bangs across the forehead, topped with a white ribbon headband. Bright cornflower blue eyes are wide and cheerful on a youthful face with a soft, mature appearance. A slender build is dressed in a green sleeveless dress with a white furry trim shawl and a brown strap crossing the chest. A small green leaf-shaped pendant hangs from a thin gold necklace.
